cards.jpg.description: I had four days at Wimbledon this year. I didn't go to the qualifying this time - maybe I'll do that again next year - but queued for ground passes the first two days. It's years since I'd done that, but these days it's relatively painless. We joined the queue about 6 am, which was in time to get Court 1 or 2 tickets. We didn't really queue in the rain as the sticker claims - just a bit of drizzle for the first hour or so on the Monday. In the second week I was able to go twice, on Wednesday and Friday, this time with tickets in advance. The photos in this set are from a lot of first round matches, plus men's quarter-finals and semi-finals. What I missed out on this year was doubles, unlike last year when I saw lots of doubles matches, mainly towards the end of the first week. Must see more doubles next year!
cards.jpg.author: Carine06 from UK

sticker.jpg.description: With Wimbledon over for another year, I have been checking that I have documented all my tournament memorabilia. This sticker has adorned our filing cabinet since 1994 and for some reason I have never photographed it! Checking whether that could have been the year I was forced to buy the big Wimbledon umbrella, Google tells me that "Yes, it did rain during the 1994 Wimbledon Championships. The wet weather caused a few notable disruptions throughout the fortnight, most famously during the shocking first-round women's singles match where defending champion Steffi Graf was upset by Lori McNeil, which was interrupted by two rain delays"
sticker.jpg.author: Amanda Slater
